items.jp: コンピューター関係の仕事をしています。

translation.pt-BR: Trabalho com algo relacionado a computadores.
translation.en: I do work related to computers.

items.label: connector (て-form) for the auxiliary いる
items.explanation: て links して to いる, forming 〜ている (continuous state): 'I am doing / I work with'.

items.jp: 見て！ウサギだ！

translation.pt-BR: Olha! Um coelho!
translation.en: Look! A bunny!

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 見る ao que vem depois (ウサギ) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 彼は舞台の上にたっている。

translation.pt-BR: Ele está em cima do palco.
translation.en: He is standing on the stage.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga たつ ao que vem depois (いる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 彼は夫人を一緒につれてきた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele veio acompanhado da esposa.
translation.en: He was accompanied by his wife.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga つれる ao que vem depois (くる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 彼は抜け目がないというよりついているのだ。

translation.pt-BR: Mais do que esperto, ele tem é sorte.
translation.en: He is more lucky than clever.

items.explanation: Connective particle (て-form) linking ついて to the rest, marking the ongoing state/action.
tokens: subject of the clause 抜け目がない
predicate of the rejected description (negation/existence auxiliary)
verb of the というより block (quotation/description)

items.jp: 彼は馬と牛を育てている。

translation.pt-BR: Ele cria cavalos e bois.
translation.en: He raises horses and cattle.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て liga 育てる ao que vem depois (いる) e encadeia os dois dentro da mesma frase.

items.jp: 彼は破産している。

translation.pt-BR: Ele está falido.
translation.en: He is bankrupt.

items.label: connective particle (て form)

items.jp: 彼は日記を付けている。

translation.pt-BR: Ele mantém um diário.

items.label: connective particle (て form)

items.jp: 彼は頭をまっすぐにしていた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele estava mantendo a cabeça reta.
translation.en: He held his head straight.

items.label: connective particle (-te form)
items.explanation: て links the verb して to the auxiliary いる, forming している/していた, which expresses a continuous action or maintained state.
tokens: auxiliary (links the na-adjective to する)

items.jp: 彼は度々遅れてきます。

translation.pt-BR: Ele chega atrasado com frequência.
translation.en: He often comes late.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links 受け to みる to form ～てみる ('try doing').
tokens: main verb of the matrix clause

translation.en: He understands her problems more or less.

items.label: connective particle (て form)

items.jp: 彼は赤いズボンをはいていた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele estava usando uma calça vermelha.
translation.en: He wore red pants.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb はく to the auxiliary いる, forming ている (continuous state/action); here in the past it gives 'was wearing'.

items.jp: 手伝ってくれたら、夕飯ご馳走するよ。

translation.pt-BR: Se você me ajudar, eu te pago o jantar.
translation.en: I'll treat you to dinner if you help me.

items.label: links verb to the auxiliary (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 手伝っ to the auxiliary くれる, forming 手伝ってくれる ('to help on my behalf').
tokens: main verb (nominal stem of ご馳走する)
